author: claude
summary: Owner-requested: the global audio player (PlayerBar) had no volume control -- it always played at whatever the system/OS volume happened to be. Added a mute-toggle button + level slider, same as a normal media player, persisted across sessions like the theme preference.

files.change: Added volume state (0-1, loaded/saved via a new 'studio-player-volume' localStorage key, mirroring utils/theme.ts's STORAGE_KEY pattern), an effect applying it to the <audio> element whenever it or the element changes, and a volume control (mute button + range input) rendered in player-bar-content. Mute remembers the last non-zero level via prevVolumeRef so unmute restores it.
Added .player-bar-volume / .player-volume-slider styling, matching the existing .player-progress-slider treatment but fixed-width.

flow_impact: Purely additive UI control; no change to playerBus state shape or existing playback behavior. Existing PlayerBar.test.tsx assertions using the ambiguous getByRole('slider')/queryByRole('slider') were switched to label-scoped queries (getByLabelText('Seek progress')) since the volume slider now also has role=slider.
